title: De-biased Distribution Estimation for Locally Differential Private Survival Data
abstract: arXiv:2610.14320v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Sharing time-to-event data can leak sensitive information about individual participants in clinical studies. To protect the privacy of data, differential privacy (DP) framework offers rigorous protection for data sharing. The local variant of differential privacy is particularly appealing because each record is perturbed before it leaves the data owner or contributor. However, the injected perturbation distorts the true distribution of the source data, yielding low utility and invalid statistical inference with the released data. In this work, we propose a nonparametric estimator for the true survivor function via the deconvolution kernel function with locally differential private (LDP) right-censored survival data in which both the event times and the event indicators are privatized. Our estimator simultaneously de-biases the perturbation applied to the times and the errors induced by flipping the event indicators due to LDP. Theoreti

translated_title: 局部差分隐私生存数据的去偏分布估计
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.14320v1 公告类型：交叉。摘要：共享事件时间数据可能会泄露临床研究中个体参与者的敏感信息。为了保护数据隐私，差分隐私（DP）框架为数据共享提供了严格的保护。差分隐私的局部变体尤其具有吸引力，因为每条记录在离开数据所有者或贡献者之前就已经被扰动。然而，注入的扰动会扭曲源数据的真实分布，导致发布的数据效用低下且统计推断无效。在这项工作中，我们针对局部差分隐私（LDP）的右删失生存数据（其中事件时间和事件指示变量均被私有化），通过反卷积核函数提出了真实生存函数的非参数估计量。我们的估计量能够同时对施加于时间的扰动以及由LDP导致事件指示变量翻转所产生的误差进行去偏。理论（此处摘要被截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种基于反卷积核函数的非参数估计方法，可同时消除局部差分隐私对事件时间的扰动偏差和事件指示变量翻转带来的误差，从而对右删失生存数据的真实生存函数实现去偏估计。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a nonparametric estimator based on deconvolution kernel functions that simultaneously de-biases the perturbation applied to event times and the errors induced by flipping event indicators under local differential privacy, enabling debiased estimation of the true survivor function for right-censored survival data.
